header.business: A US criminal and traffic defense law firm

scorecard.key_number: auto-tagging on, tracking managed in this account
scorecard.why: Auto-tagging is on, conversion tracking is managed by the account itself, and it owns its own conversion actions.

scorecard.key_number: 5 counted actions; 1 lead action counts every conversion
scorecard.why: 'Phone Call' (UPLOAD_CLICKS, CONTACT) counts MANY_PER_CLICK, and 3 call actions are counted side by side, so one caller can be counted more than once.
'Live Chat' is counted in the goal but recorded nothing between 2026-07-04 and 2026-10-01. The other 4 counted actions all recorded a conversion in the last 3 days, and none stopped in the last week.

scorecard.key_number: 93% of counted conversions arrive within a day
scorecard.why: 90% have arrived by day 1. No counted action shows more than 5% of its conversions at the edge of its window. Windows are mixed: 30 and 90 days.
One API client uploads to 'Phone Call'. One upload failed on 2026-09-04; the uploads after it succeeded. Volume is small: 2 conversions in 30 days against 181 from the other counted actions.

scorecard.key_number: customer data terms accepted, enhanced conversions for leads on
scorecard.why: Account side is ready. Whether the website tags send enhanced conversions can only be read from the GTM container, which isn't connected for this site.

scorecard.key_number: 0 of 1 connected containers belong to this site
scorecard.why: The only connected GTM container is for a different website, and the firm's site answers automated requests with a bot check ('Just a moment...'), so its container id couldn't be read.

scorecard.key_number: 0 of 3 connected GA4 properties belong to this business
scorecard.why: The connected properties are other businesses. In Google Ads, all 20 GA4-imported actions are hidden, so GA4 feeds nothing into bidding today.

lag.advice: Leave out the last 1 day before judging a CPA or a change.

top_fixes.fix: Connect the site's GTM container and GA4 property
top_fixes.spend_steered: all ~$5560 of 30-day spend: tag coverage can't be checked without them
top_fixes.evidence: 1 connected container belongs to another site; 3 connected GA4 properties belong to other businesses
top_fixes.who: add them in the InsightfulPipe MCP, then run this skill again

top_fixes.spend_steered: ~$5270 a month on 7 campaigns with conversion-based bidding
top_fixes.evidence: conversion_action query: UPLOAD_CLICKS, CONTACT, MANY_PER_CLICK, 90-day window; 2 conversions in 30 days
top_fixes.who: do this in Google Ads (Goals, the action, Count: One). update_conversion_action has no counting field; the alternative is a new ONE_PER_CLICK action with create_conversion_action, then setting this one to secondary.

top_fixes.spend_steered: same ~$5270: 'Calls from ads', 'Call or Text', 'Phone Call' are all counted
top_fixes.evidence: 'Calls from ads' AD_CALL 73 in 30 days; 'Call or Text' WEBPAGE 62 in 30 days; 'Phone Call' UPLOAD_CLICKS 2 in 30 days
top_fixes.who: check with the firm whether a caller from an ad can also trigger the website call tag and the uploaded call. If so, I can set the duplicates to secondary with update_conversion_action (primary_for_goal: false) after you confirm.

top_fixes.spend_steered: no direct spend, but a counted action that never fires may mean the chat tag broke
top_fixes.evidence: daily query 2026-07-04 to 2026-10-01: 0 conversions; it is primary and counted
top_fixes.who: test the chat on the site. If chat is gone, I can set the action to HIDDEN with update_conversion_action after you confirm.

everything_else: 5 primary actions are not counted because their goals aren't biddable (the Google-hosted local actions: website visits, calls, directions, other engagements, menu views). That looks intended for a law firm.
36 hidden actions are clutter: 16 old Universal Analytics goals and 20 GA4 imports. 16 of them still say include in conversions but record nothing.
All 9 enabled campaigns use the account's goals (goal_config_level CUSTOMER); none has a custom goal.
Every counted action uses data-driven attribution.
No campaign bids on value, so the default values of 0 and 1 do no harm.
Lag: 93% within 1 day, 97% within 7, 98% within 14. Leave out the last 1 day before judging a CPA.
unknowns: Tags on the site: the connected GTM container is for another website, and the firm's site blocks automated fetches.
Web enhanced conversions: visible only in the GTM conversion tags.
GA4: no property for this business is connected.
Enhanced conversions for leads imports: Google shows their health only in the Google Ads diagnostics screen, not in the API report.
